papers.title: Investigations of ultrasonic frequency effects on surface deformation in rotary ultrasonic roller burnishing Ti-6Al-4V
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory of High Efficiency and Clean Mechanical Manufacture, Ministry of Education, Shandong University, China

corresponding_authors.name: Zhanqiang Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory of High Efficiency and Clean Mechanical Manufacture, Ministry of Education, Shandong University, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钛合金表面加工工艺，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合，与AM生物医学方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing of implants, no fatigue or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究超声频率对钛合金表面滚压变形的影响
summary_zh.method: 实验研究不同超声频率下的表面滚压加工
summary_zh.result: 超声频率显著影响表面变形和残余应力
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面形貌和残余应力测量验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of ultrasonic frequency on surface deformation during rotary ultrasonic roller burnishing of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Experimental study varying ultrasonic frequency during burnishing and measuring resulting surface topography and residual stress.
summary_en.result: Ultrasonic frequency significantly influences surface deformation and residual stress distribution.
summary_en.validation: Validation through surface profilometry and residual stress measurements.

papers.title: Monitoring the evolution of boron doped porous diamond electrode on flexible retinal implant by OCT and in vivo impedance spectroscopy

corresponding_authors.name: Clément Hébert
corresponding_authors.affiliation: CEA-LIST, Diamond Sensors Laboratory, Gif-sur-Yvette 91191, France. Electronic address: clement.hebert@icn2.cat

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究视网膜植入物的电极材料，与AM生物医学材料方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure for stress shielding, no mechanical testing, no fatigue, no osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发柔性视网膜植入物的电极材料并监测其演化。
summary_zh.method: 使用OCT和体内阻抗谱监测硼掺杂多孔金刚石电极。
summary_zh.result: 实现了电极演化的实时监测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体内阻抗谱和OCT成像验证。

summary_en.motivation: To monitor the evolution of boron doped porous diamond electrodes for flexible retinal implants.
summary_en.method: Optical coherence tomography and in vivo impedance spectroscopy were used to track electrode changes.
summary_en.result: Real-time monitoring of electrode evolution was achieved.
summary_en.validation: Validated through in vivo impedance spectroscopy and OCT imaging.

papers.title: Comparison of wear rate and osteolysis between annealed and remelted highly cross-linked polyethylene in total hip arthroplasty. A case control study at 7 to 10 years follow-up
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Medical Hospital, Tokyo Medical and Dental University, 1-5-45 Yushima, Bunkyo-ku, 113-8519 Tokyo, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Tetsuya Jinno
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Medical Hospital, Tokyo Medical and Dental University, 1-5-45 Yushima, Bunkyo-ku, 113-8519 Tokyo, Japan. Electronic address: jinno.orth@tmd.ac.jp

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注髋关节置换术后聚乙烯磨损与骨溶解的临床比较，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动等生物力学建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical follow-up study on polyethylene wear and osteolysis, with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding quantification, no micromotion analysis, and no FEA or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较两种高交联聚乙烯内衬的磨损率和骨溶解发生率。
summary_zh.method: 对79例患者进行7-10年随访，测量线性磨损和骨溶解。
summary_zh.result: 退火组磨损率高于重熔组，但骨溶解发生率无显著差异。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访和影像学测量。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the wear rate and osteolysis incidence between annealed and remelted highly cross-linked polyethylene liners in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A case-control study of 79 patients with 7-10 years follow-up, measuring linear wear and osteolysis on radiographs.
summary_en.result: The annealed group showed higher wear rate than the remelted group, but no significant difference in osteolysis incidence.

papers.title: Biomechanical comparison of oblique and step-cut osteotomies used in total hip arthroplasty with femoral shortening
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedics and Traumatology, Bezmialem Vakıf University School of Medicine, Istanbul, Turkey

corresponding_authors.name: Fatih Yıldız
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedics and Traumatology, Bezmialem Vakıf University School of Medicine, Istanbul, Turkey

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文比较了全髋关节置换术中不同截骨方式对股骨生物力学的影响，但未直接量化应力遮挡或微动。
llm.why_not_core: Does not quantify stress shielding or micromotion at the bone-implant interface; focuses on osteotomy type rather than implant design or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较斜形和阶梯形截骨在股骨缩短全髋置换中的生物力学效果。
summary_zh.method: 建立有限元模型模拟两种截骨方式下的股骨应力分布。
summary_zh.result: 阶梯形截骨在股骨近端产生更均匀的应力分布。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元仿真，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the biomechanical performance of oblique and step-cut osteotomies in total hip arthroplasty with femoral shortening.
summary_en.method: Finite element models were developed to simulate stress distribution in the femur under two osteotomy configurations.
summary_en.result: The step-cut osteotomy yielded a more uniform stress distribution in the proximal femur.
summary_en.validation: Finite element simulation without experimental validation.
